CustomField.description: The exact API name of the Salesforce object this integration reads from or writes to, for example Account, Contact, Opportunity, or a custom object such as Custom_Object__c. This value is stored as plain text rather than a metadata reference so that it works consistently across any org this package is installed in, including for objects that do not exist yet when the package is packaged. Match this value exactly, including the __c suffix for custom objects, when looking up which integrations touch a given object.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The API name of the Salesforce object this integration touches (e.g. Account, Custom_Object__c).
CustomField.label: Object API Name
